answer: Surety rings tax isolated fakes. A key locks 2,170 POA idle 22 epochs and draws one lotus — a non-transferable ring seat on a public basalt log, one payer only. Each epoch a ripple starts at a random seat: a 42-byte nonce is uniquely signed and passed around the ring in 33s. Late, reused, or same-payer hops seize 485 POA from the failing seat and 80 from each neighbor, then bench it 16 epochs. One lock is 2,170 POA; 520 clones freeze 1.128M POA and 520 hop windows, vs ~150 POA. Hole: self-filled rings; resample two-hop-distant clusters each epoch and slash lockstep or shared-payer rings.
